title: IBM OM shared-destination baseline and spacing under P&V
hypothesis: For four-device shared-destination-column initialization, decreasing uniform level spacing will improve ideal quantized accuracy until stochastic program-and-verify can no longer persistently distinguish adjacent targets, while moving the baseline from the highest commissioned RESET state toward the center of the common destination-column interval will trade upward level capacity for downward RESET headroom and greater physical loading; consequently the practical optimum will be identifiable only from matched ideal and persistent P&V endpoints over the joint baseline-position-by-spacing design.
motivation: The completed baseline-selection study chose shared_destination_columns_reset_max as the practical exact-zero policy at a frozen four-delta diagnostic, but it did not choose baseline position, level spacing, or P&V behavior jointly. This study retains the same frozen ReLU source, four-device topology, assignment identities, commissioning, joint repair, destination grouping, full-conductance KCL evaluation, and development/held-out split while varying only alpha in B=L+alpha(U-L) and h in {1,2,4} delta_x. Each native run evaluates its exact ideal target and five matched persistent stochastic P&V repeats with inference read noise off; continuous calibration is selected once per alpha and frozen across all three spacings.

completion_criteria: All 27 declared native validate runs complete from frozen ReLU source SHA-256 9a961a77628e365b54fdf59304ec7fddf46f1f4834c4c03cecea9c204f837f52. Each run recomputes development assignment 86001 identically, evaluates exactly one held-out assignment 87001-87003 on all 10000 test examples, records one ideal-quantized endpoint, and records exactly five persistent P&V repeat endpoints.

Every production config requires runtime.device=cuda. The formal launcher must pass a live CUDA canary using the exact strict runtime before it prepares or launches any full task; no CPU result may satisfy coverage.

The excluded smoke-alpha_000_spacing_4delta-heldout-87001 CUDA canary exercises the full physical assignment, mapping, artifact, and five-repeat P&V path while evaluating exactly 32 test examples. It runs outside the canonical study runs root, is absent from declared production coverage, and cannot satisfy or replace a production config.

For each held-out seed, all nine designs use the same jointly repaired identities and eight-read RESET commissioning observations as the completed baseline-selection study and have matching population, donor-selection, commissioning, source, topology, solver, and data fingerprints. Repair occurs before the intervention and cannot depend on ideal or P&V outcomes.

The baseline is B_j=L_j+alpha(U_j-L_j), with L_j the maximum bounded commissioned RESET mean and U_j the minimum sampled upper bound within each destination-column pair. Alpha is exactly one of 0, 0.25, or 0.5, spacing is exactly one, two, or four times delta_x=nominal_dw_min/2, and logical initialization uses nonnegative sign-selected integer levels with half-step ties away from zero.

Every rail target is finite, nonnegative, and within its sampled bounds; every saved ideal mapping satisfies G_target=B+n*h exactly; and full G enters both signed transfer and conductance-sum loading. Zero baseline contrast is exact before offsets. Incomplete coverage, donor exhaustion, decomposition failure, or population mismatch invalidates the run.

Each alpha independently selects one scale pair and positive gain only from continuous bounded development mapping over the identical candidate grid and objective. That alpha-specific calibration is byte-identical across all three spacings and frozen for held-out ideal mapping and P&V. Quantized development outcomes, held-out labels, apparent reads, persistent endpoints, pulse costs, and failures cannot refit it.

At alpha=0 and h=4 delta_x, held-out ideal mapping exactly reproduces finalized shared_destination_columns_reset_max correct counts 9098, 8580, and 8889 and prediction hashes 32714304647fba730bfd769b8d5b43cf5d6b3dad7cbf049da595a7f3f2c0a4d6, 3be15ece3ad194e70c846d4207ef3b097162b72ae39764c0f405a759dfe0789f, and 43ddf6df2b0c685a185ed2d8fe946d848259e32d5df3c8c02286b1a92512980f for assignments 87001-87003, with scale fractions 1.0 and 1.0 and logit gain 14.12537544622754.

Held-out assignments 87001, 87002, and 87003 use endpoint-seed lists [89101,89102,89103,89104,89105], [89201,89202,89203,89204,89205], and [89301,89302,89303,89304,89305], respectively, matched across all nine designs. The explicit one_pulse controller starts from the conditioned lower state, receives only the target, apparent raw-x verify values, and its own history, uses an absolute verify tolerance of 0.5 delta_x independent of h, and has at most 128 programming pulses. Persistent state is recorded in the same raw x=(a+1)/2 coordinate. Cycle-to-cycle and apparent verify noise are enabled; inference read noise is exactly off.

Every P&V run saves unmodified apparent and persistent native raw-x endpoints but uses the persistent endpoint for headline network accuracy after the declared passive-circuit handoff hard-projects raw x to the public [0,1] conductance coordinate. Below/above masks, projection deltas, and counts are mandatory, and the projection does not modify controller observations or continuation state. Apparent acceptance, persistent target reachability, verify-window intersection, public-coordinate projection, saturation, and budget exhaustion are classified separately; apparent admission is never treated as proof of a persistently correct code.

Optimizer updates, BPTT, QAT, HWA, retention, drift, logical rewrites, and post-deployment recovery are absent. The study cannot establish bidirectional updateability, cross-hardware training transfer, fabricated-device behavior, or the need for on-chip recovery.

A design passes the ideal gate only at mean held-out ideal quantized accuracy of at least 90 percent. Among passing designs, compare each design's sum of persistent correct counts over five paired seeds at each held-out assignment, with denominator 50000. A unique practical winner must have a strictly larger assignment-level sum than every other eligible design at all three assignments and lead the runner-up mean over all 150000 predictions by at least 1.00 percentage point; otherwise the result is inconclusive/no unique winner.
analysis_plan: Verify exact run/config/source coverage, CUDA receipts, development calibration receipts, assignment and endpoint seeds, hardware and commissioning semantic fingerprints, full-G mapping hashes, P&V replay state, prediction hashes, exact counts, and all artifact bindings before comparing designs.

For each assignment and design, report exact correct/10000, top-1 accuracy, teacher agreement, KL, paired flips, and prediction hashes for the ideal quantized endpoint and each of five persistent P&V repeats, plus the alpha-specific continuous-envelope and apparent-endpoint diagnostics at the same frozen calibration.

Report B, L, U, zero contrast, total loading, directional whole-level capacities N_down and N_up, zero-only groups, effective level counts, target-index distributions, and per-layer RMS(C)/mean(L) and voltage statistics. Keep the two destination-column groups explicit; do not infer absolute-Siemens power from the normalized OM coordinate.

Report target-to-apparent and target-to-persistent conductance errors both by layer and, separately, by requested level, including signed mean, MAE, RMSE, p50, p95, maximum, nearest-code and adjacent-code confusion. Reconstruct DRN weight errors versus the frozen ReLU weights only from full conductances and include relative L2, cosine similarity, sign reversals, and erased weights.

Separate exact persistent reachability, verify-window intersection, apparent acceptance, failure, clipping, saturation, and budget exhaustion. Report SET, RESET, total pulse and verify-read counts, reversals, and their distributions rather than pooling structural and controller failures.

Present the 3-by-3 ideal and five-repeat-mean persistent-accuracy matrices, their ideal-to-P&V drops, per-assignment repeat distributions, full paired assignment ranges, and baseline-position-by-spacing interactions. Verify alpha-specific continuous calibration parity across spacings and the exact historical alpha=0,h=4 ideal parity gate. Do not treat three assignments as a confidence interval and do not let pulse-cost diagnostics alter the predeclared decision rule.

Apply the 90-percent ideal gate and unique P&V-winner rule. Report the best ideal design separately from the practical persistent winner, and explicitly bound conclusions to four-device shared-destination initialization in the normalized OM preset without training or rewrites.
